g1.instruction: Write the correct letter, A–J, next to each question.

g2.title: Hypocaust cross-section (furnace under the west end of the hot room)
g2.instruction: Write the correct letter, A–J, next to each question.
g2.layout: Layout: ground level runs along the bottom; the furnace sits under the west end of the hot room. A = opening at the foot of the left-hand wall, into the furnace · B = row of supports under the floor · C = horizontal layer across the bottom of the hot room · D = inside the right-hand wall · E = top right, above the right-hand wall · F = pit in the ground below the furnace · G = far left, above ground · H = underground corridor, bottom left · I = small opening in the left-hand wall, just above floor level · J = opening in the floor near the right-hand wall
